parameters.query:
SELECT
    a.account_id,

    ag.agreement_id,
    ag.agreement_name,
    ag.agreement_type,
    ag.effective_from AS agreement_effective_from,
    ag.effective_to AS agreement_effective_to,
    ag.status AS agreement_status,

    ce.entitlement_id,
    ce.entitlement_type,
    ce.effective_from AS entitlement_effective_from,
    ce.effective_to AS entitlement_effective_to,
    ce.status AS entitlement_status

FROM accounts a

LEFT JOIN agreements ag
    ON ag.account_id = a.account_id

LEFT JOIN commercial_entitlements ce
    ON ce.agreement_id = ag.agreement_id
    AND ce.account_id = a.account_id

WHERE a.account_id = $1

ORDER BY
    ag.effective_from DESC NULLS LAST,
    ag.agreement_id ASC,
    ce.entitlement_id ASC;
